cards.title: Ai2 Open-Sources AstaBrief 8B: 3.5× Faster Scientific Report Generation from Qwen3-8B
cards.why_it_matters: As an AI/ML engineer you may need to run scientific synthesis locally or adapt open-weight models for domain-specific long-form generation — AstaBrief's training recipe and open weights give you a reproducible starting point for both.
cards.summary: Ai2 fine-tuned Qwen3-8B into AstaBrief 8B for citation-grounded scientific report generation. Post-training used tens of thousands of real research queries, citation-focused filtering, and preference data. A single-pass pipeline (vs. section-by-section) cuts generation to 51.1s vs. 178.5s for Claude-powered Thinking mode (~3.5× faster). Weights, training data, and an example PDF workflow are fully open-sourced.
